endpoints.label: Endpoints
endpoints.hint: A CSV list of PostgreSQL instances to scrape. Each endpoint must be in the Connection URI format.

tls.ca_file.label: Certificate Authority File
tls.ca_file.hint: Absolute path to an additional CA certificate file.

exclude_databases.label: Exclude Databases
exclude_databases.hint: A CSV list of databases to match (by using POSIX Regular Expressions) against the datname column for which you don’t want to collect metrics from.

include_databases.label: Include Databases
include_databases.hint: A CSV list of databases to match (by using POSIX Regular Expressions) against the datname column for which you want to collect metrics from.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.hint: Overrides the default namespace for the metrics emitted by the source.

scrape_interval_secs.label: Scrape Interval Secs
scrape_interval_secs.hint: The interval between scrapes, in seconds.
